priorityList: Maintain Windfury Weapon, Flametongue Weapon, and Lightning Shield at all times.
Cast Voltaic Blaze or Flame Shock if the target does not have Flame Shock ticking.
Cast Sundering if Whirling Earth is active or the Surging Elements talent is taken.
Cast Lava Lash if Whirling Fire is active.
Cast Doom Winds on cooldown for massive physical damage and windfury procs.
Cast Ascendance if Thorim's Invocation is talented to trigger automatic Chain Lightnings.
Cast Tempest at 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon, unless currently in Ascendance or Doom Winds.
Cast Primordial Storm at 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
Cast Chain Lightning when at 9 or 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
Cast Crash Lightning if Whirling Air is active or to maintain the Crash Lightning cleave buff.
Cast Windstrike or Stormstrike during Doom Winds and Ascendance windows, especially if Whirling Air is active.
Cast Voltaic Blaze whenever it procs from your totem.
Cast Lava Lash as your primary filler, especially if your Searing Totem from the hero tree is active.
Cast Chain Lightning as a filler if you have 5 or more stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
